content.text:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary above to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The summary has no dates, durations, or job count, so I can't state or calculate your years of experience. I won't guess or default to the posting's "8 years," because an invented figure on a résumé is a credibility risk if checked.

**How many years of backend engineering experience do you have?** If it's under 8, give me the real number anyway. I can frame it around scope and impact instead.

**What it costs to leave it out:**
- **Automated screening:** Many applicant tracking systems filter on an explicit year count. A summary without one may never reach a human.
- **Recruiter skim:** The posting states one hard requirement. A summary that doesn't address it makes the reader search your work history, and many won't.
- **Inference against you:** Leaving out years can read as having too few to mention.
- **Weaker rewrite:** Without the figure, I can only gesture at seniority ("extensive," "seasoned"), which carries little weight next to a number.

**Draft with placeholder** (drop in your figure):

> Backend engineer with **[X] years** of experience building transactional services. Most recently built and operated a settlement pipeline processing 40,000 orders per day. Prior work spans payment reconciliation and inventory systems.

**Fallback if you'd rather not state years** (weaker against this posting):

> Backend engineer specializing in high-volume transactional systems. Most recently built and operated a settlement pipeline processing 40,000 orders per day, following earlier work on payment reconciliation and inventory platforms.

Send the number and I'll finalize it. Start and end dates for each role would also let me check the total and strengthen the progression.
